info.reasonInvalid: Google Sheet Direct Buy value is ignored

inputs.utterance: create a calc to convert Spend Category to numeric values sorted by alphabetic order

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: CASE [Spend Category] WHEN 'Adwords' THEN 1 WHEN 'ALPO' THEN 2 WHEN 'Baidu' THEN 3 WHEN 'Bing' THEN 4 WHEN 'DCM' THEN 5 WHEN 'Eloqua Form' THEN 6 WHEN 'Facebook' THEN 7 WHEN 'GA' THEN 8 WHEN 'Google Sheet Direct Buy' THEN 9 WHEN 'LinkedIn' THEN 10 WHEN 'Twitter' THEN 11 ELSE 0 END
